Pick Up Where You Left Off
KnitTools keeps your count, your place in the pattern and your project details together. Put your work down any time and come back to exactly the right spot.
No account needed. Your projects stay on this phone.
Add the project you\'re working on, or start a new one.
Already started? Enter how far you\'ve got.
See how many are left as you go.
When you finish a row, tap +. Tapping the big number works too.
When you finish a round, tap +. Tapping the big number works too.
When you finish a repeat, tap +. Tapping the big number works too.
Tap + each time you finish one. Tapping the big number works too.
Saved. Tapped by mistake? Undo takes back the last change.
Counting more than one at a time? Change how much each tap adds here.
Want to know how long this project takes? Start a work session from this menu. Time never starts on its own.
This is your whole project: pattern, yarn, notes and photos. Continue takes you back to the counter.
Attach your pattern to keep it with this project.
Turn on Follow main counter and the reading line moves as you count.
Screen going dark while you work? Keep it on while you count.
Target reached. Keep counting, or mark the project finished from the project page menu.
Your first work session is saved. The total time for this project is here.
Your projects are only on this phone. Make a backup so they\'re safe if you switch phones.
Lots of projects? Sort them into folders from the title.
Count from your home screen without opening the app.
The calculators work offline. Example values show what to enter.
Pick what you\'re doing right now. You can come back here any time.
Counter, Undo and your project page
Tap + when you finish a row. Tapping the big number also increases the count. Minus decreases it. The amount depends on your step size.
Undo steps back through your recent changes, one tap at a time.
The ×1 ring between the buttons sets how much each tap adds, from 1 to 99, separately for each project.
Tapping a project opens its project page with the pattern, yarn, notes and photos. Continue opens the counter.
A project you\'ve started waits at the top of Projects, ready to continue.
Add the counter widget to count without opening the app.
PDFs, web patterns and the reading line
Add a PDF from your phone or cloud storage, or save a link to a web pattern.
A project can hold several PDFs. Each one remembers its own page.
Reading mode gives the page the whole screen. Mark up adds pens, highlighters, text and chart tools.
Turn on Follow main counter and the line moves as you count. Calibrate counter positions once if your rows don\'t line up.
Bookmark the spots you keep coming back to.
Open Ravelry in the app, sign in on Ravelry\'s own page, and download PDFs you own straight into KnitTools.
Photograph the pages and KnitTools turns them into a PDF.
Project yarn, amounts and My Yarn
Note the yarn you\'re using in the project, with planned, allocated and used amounts.
Remaining is what\'s left of the yarn allocated to this project. Your stash numbers don\'t change on their own.
Save yarn once with color number, dye lot and photos, then link it to any project.
Notes, extra counters, reminders and photos
Keep needle sizes, changes and what comes next.
Track pattern repeats, increases and decreases, or sections of rows alongside the main counter.
Get a reminder in the app when you reach a row, like the next decrease. Reminders show inside KnitTools, not as phone notifications.
Take photos as your project grows. The newest one becomes the project\'s picture.
Tools, work time, Insights and backup
Gauge, increases and decreases, cast-on and yarn amounts. They work offline.
Needle sizes, size charts, abbreviations and chart symbols live in Library.
Start a work session from the project menu to track your time. Stop when you\'re done to save or discard it.
See the time you\'ve recorded. Pro adds daily, weekly and monthly charts and your streak.
Group projects into folders from the Projects title. One project in progress at a time is free, and finished projects don\'t count.
Make a backup file and keep it somewhere safe, like your cloud drive. Restoring replaces your current KnitTools data on this phone.
Touch and hold your home screen, choose Widgets, then find KnitTools.
The free version keeps one project in progress at a time. Try Pro free for 14 days to add all your projects.
